content_html_sanitized:
First, for me, this is a case of Deja Vu all over again.

See   When I Say That Marijuana Prohibition Causes Long Term Memory Loss, The Story of “BC Bud” Is The Best Evidence.

 

The big story here is supposedly that some risk taking “tourists” are smuggling “large quantities” in vacuum sealed bags of “Cali Weed”, (hooray for Hollywood) in checked bags on their flights back from Lalaland, to the UK where it fetches £420 per ounce, or something like that.

 

Now, here is where the story swerves from silly to Prohibitionist propaganda: “The increased presence of THC in a form of cannabis known as skunk in Britain caused the government to move the drug from the lowest level of illegal categorization, Class C, to Class B in 2009, citing concerns over the “onset of psychotic illness and the increased risk to mental health from the use of stronger cannabis.”

Nope. See 500 UK Cannabis Smokers A Week Seek Medical Help In Hospitals Since Downgrading? Or 2 Major UK Papers Lie to Their Readers. Guess Which.

 

And remember, this is a contraband market. No one knows what anyone is smoking. No one actually knows if “Skunk” is actually Skunk.

See The Problems with “Synthetic Cannabis” Begin With Its Name

 

A criminology professor in northern England is quoted as saying that the type of cannabis traditionally sold in Britain had THC levels of 3 to 5 percent. That seems utterly absurd. There are illegal growers all over the country and I think even I could do better than that.

 

He also said that “skunk is normally found to have 10 to 20 percent”.

A 100% range? Then he said, “Cannabis sold as Cali weed has far higher levels of THC, he said, up to 40 percent.”

 

Really, more than what the California dispensaries are selling? Maybe they should be smuggling it to Cali?

 

Although there is nothing new about increasing average levels of THC, (It’s been increasing since the 1970s) the only way to know for sure is to buy it directly from a licensed dispensary in a legal state.

 

In California, it ranges from the mid 20% to the low 30%

See California's notoriously strong cannabis is suddenly getting weaker

 

That is probably as good as the plant can get, until it improves on its way to England!

 

And perhaps His Majesty’s narcs should have also told the Times about the weed being smuggled in from Thailand. I haven’t seen any reports on its average THC levels.

See Why Is It Thailand’s Fault That Stupid Tourists from Stupid Prohibitionist Countries Try to Smuggle Out Cannabis? and links

What would they do without Cali Weed? Doesn’t all this prove that cannabis prohibition is just a subsidy to the black market?

 

There are  approximately two million cannabis users in the UK. Cannabis is being grown all over the country. It is being smuggled in from all over the world. People are being arrested. And the UK has some of the highest rates of overdose deaths in Europe.

 

So the New York Times is reporting about a few suitcases of “Cali Weed” and parroting the prohibitionist party line.

 

From 2007 see The Iron Law of Prohibition: Potent Pot, New Data and the Old Prohibitionist Party Line and Another Lie , and especially the Ben Goldacre column at the end.
